notes: Cobra head for mogul-base HID lamps (HPS 70 to 250 W, with metal halide and PSMH also listed); the HID version is supplied without lamps. The housing is die-cast aluminium and the lens is tempered glass.

gaps: The sheet lists no ballast capacitor or ignitor, so none is claimed; the SDQ and STP starter options are listed without saying what they start, so no starter part is claimed.
Spec sheet revision 12/18 (copyright 2019); whether this head is still in the current catalogue was not checked.

Voltage is given as the luminaire's ordering option; the sheet does not state it separately for the ballast. The record uses the multi-tap 120-277 V option; a multi-tap 347-480 V option is also listed.
Ordering guide lamps: HPS 70, 100, 150, 200 and 250 W, MH 100 and 150 W, PSMH 175 and 250 W. The record's watt range covers the HPS sizes.
The sheet gives no ballast weight or core construction (it says only magnetic), so none is claimed.
method: Spec sheet 'Helios HBS Cobra Head', HBS-Helios_SpecSheet 12/18 (2 pages), read with node tools/research.js pdf; both pages rendered at 130 dpi and the lamp holder, ballast, ballast tray, housing, lens, reflector and weight blocks read from the images because the text layer interleaves the columns.
Hosted on the Signify asset server; page 1 carries the Lumec by Signify logo and page 2 the Signify North America and Canada addresses and lumec.com.

comps.spec: HPS lamp, mogul base, 70, 100 and 150 W (bulb ED23.5) or 200 and 250 W (ED18) by ordering code; metal halide 100 and 150 W and PSMH 175 and 250 W are also listed. Lamps are not included on the HID version.

Magnetic ballast for HPS and PSMH lamps, power factor 90%; lamp starting down to -40 C for HPS and -30 C for MH. Assembled on a unitized removable tray with a quick-disconnect plug. Voltage options: multi-tap 120-277 V or multi-tap 347-480 V (or single 120, 208, 240, 277, 347 or 480 V).
Ballast tray of 18 gauge galvanised steel, pivoting and removable without tools.
Flat or sag lens of clear tempered glass, 0.20 in (5 mm) thick and shock resistant; the lens frame is die-cast A383 aluminium.

Hydroformed 3002-0 aluminium reflector, chemically brightened and anodised (5 micron minimum); the Smartseal optical system is rated IP66. Cut-off and semi-cut-off distributions, with sag or flat lens.
Photoelectric cell option (PH8), or a receptacle for a twist-lock photoelectric cell or a shorting cap (RC).
Lamp holder: porcelain, thermo-resistant, pulse rated 4 kV, mogul base.
Die-cast A383 aluminium alloy housing, 0.100 in (2.54 mm) minimum thickness. Luminaire weight 27 lb with the sag lens or 26 lb with the flat lens; EPA 1.47 or 1.40 sq ft.
